title: Text Processing
motto: Language is continuous. Models are discrete. Preprocessing is the bridge.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Language is continuous. Models are discrete. Preprocessing is the bridge.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A model cannot read "The cats were running." It reads integers.

Every NLP system opens with the same three questions. Where does a word start. What is the root of the word. How do we treat "run", "running", "ran" as the same thing when it helps, and as different things when it doesn't.
